newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ATX sets new closing record.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ATX sets new closing record.

text.p: Austria's ATX index advanced 1.04 percent on Wednesday to the highest close since its 1991 launch. Traders said dollar strength and a positive international environment were helping the broad market.
Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien surged more than six percent, boosted by "buy" recommendations.
The underlying tone was bullish, according to traders, and a test of 1,500 points by the ATX was on the cards.
* Top gainer Flughafen Wien up 6.10 pct at 557 schillings in wake of recent "buy" recommendations.
* Leading loser paper maker Leykam, down 1.48 pct at 343.85 schillings. Dutch parent KNP BT to detail H1 earnings on Thursday.
* August ATX future up 16.7 points at 1,477.5
* Broad-based Vienna bourse index up 4.17 points, or 0.8 pct, at 525.85. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
